name: net_reconnect_gives_up_on_a_link_stuck_connecting
description: Client 2's link drops, and every new link it opens goes nowhere: it neither opens nor fails (a SYN black-holed, which the operating system may wait two minutes on). The reconnect still gives up 30 s after the loss, as it does when the links are refused: the link fails, the seat is kept for the game started again, and the others play on.

steps.msg: the link dropped, and the new one stays connecting
29 s after the loss it still waits for its seat
30 s after the loss it gives up, though its link never failed
